about.title:
From our land.
For our people.
about.description: Santos Rock is a cultural association and music festival in Costa Rica’s Los Santos region. We champion art, culture, and local and young artistic talent.
about.detail: We connect emerging bands with professional stages and established Costa Rican acts. Because the talent in our communities deserves to be heard.
